content.text: Three notable coal-fired power plants in Vietnam include the following.

content.title: Phu My 2.2 BOT Power Plant — Wikipedia
content.description: Combined-cycle gas turbine plant in Ba Ria-Vung Tau province, 715 MW.

content.text: Vinh Tan 4 (1200 MW) operates in Binh Thuan.

content.title: Vinh Tan 4 Thermal Power Plant
content.description: EVN-operated 1200 MW supercritical coal plant commissioned 2018.

content.text: Duyen Hai 3 (1245 MW) operates in Tra Vinh.

content.title: Duyen Hai Power Complex
content.description: Five-unit coal complex on the Mekong delta coast.

content.text: Hai Phong (1200 MW) operates in northern Vietnam.

content.title: Hai Phong Thermal Power Plant
content.description: Subcritical coal-fired plant, four 300 MW units.
